User asked (verbatim, via lead r12-jwt brief):
Build the four JWT feature features (the JWT section of the feature checklist): 1. jwt.IssueOnSession() Set-Auth-JWT header exposed via CORS; 2. JWT cookie cache SessionCache whose snapshot is a signed JWT; 3. jwt.JWKSPath(path) and jwt.RemoteJWKS(url); 4. RS256 and ES256 (EdDSA default) with pinned verification.
Context: plugin/jwt, docs/plugins/jwt.md, tokens.md rows. Don't commit.
Acceptance: unit tests per function, integration on three engines, task check, staticcheck, task cover.
title: JWT feature: IssueOnSession, JWT cookie cache, JWKS path/remote, RS256/ES256
